answer: Trust is earned on a long voyage. A new agent starts at tier zero on a public ivory ledger, allowed only micro-tasks; each verified job unlocks the next tier, and only agents reaching the zenith tier can touch paid work. Minting identities gains an attacker nothing: each of 1,000 fakes must still complete 50 verified micro-tasks of 30 minutes each, 50,000 tasks and 25,000 agent-hours, while an honest agent does its 50 once. Enforcement is active: colluding identities reset to tier zero, their history burned, their tasks re-audited. Limitation: honest newcomers face a slow cold start.
